# Supported languages and directives

<!-- Generated by scripts/dev/generate-docs.mjs from src/lexer/languages.mjs and src/directives/registry.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

## Languages

- **Tier 1**: Full: lexer, directive registry, documentation policy, and dedicated tests
- **Tier 2**: Standard: lexer and directive registry with representative tests
- **Tier 3**: Basic: lexer and core directives only

| Language | Tier | Extensions and file names |
| :- | :-: | :- |
| typescript | 1 | `.ts` `.mts` `.cts` |
| tsx | 1 | `.tsx` |
| javascript | 1 | `.js` `.mjs` `.cjs` |
| jsx | 1 | `.jsx` |
| python | 1 | `.py` `.pyi` `.pyw` |
| go | 1 | `.go` |
| rust | 1 | `.rs` |
| java | 1 | `.java` |
| csharp | 1 | `.cs` |
| c | 1 | `.c` `.h` |
| cpp | 1 | `.cc` `.cpp` `.cxx` `.c++` `.hh` `.hpp` `.hxx` `.ipp` `.inl` |
| kotlin | 2 | `.kt` `.kts` |
| swift | 2 | `.swift` |
| dart | 2 | `.dart` |
| ruby | 2 | `.rb` `.rake` `.gemspec` `.ru` `Gemfile` `Rakefile` `Guardfile` `Capfile` `Brewfile` |
| php | 2 | `.php` `.phtml` |
| shell | 2 | `.sh` `.bash` `.zsh` `.ksh` `.bats` `.bashrc` `.bash_profile` `.zshrc` `.profile` |
| sql | 2 | `.sql` |
| css | 2 | `.css` |
| scss | 2 | `.scss` `.less` |
| html | 2 | `.html` `.htm` `.xhtml` |
| vue | 2 | `.vue` |
| svelte | 2 | `.svelte` |
| xml | 2 | `.xml` `.svg` `.xsd` `.xsl` `.csproj` `.props` `.targets` |
| yaml | 2 | `.yml` `.yaml` |
| toml | 2 | `.toml` |
| hcl | 2 | `.tf` `.tfvars` `.hcl` |
| dockerfile | 2 | `.dockerfile` `Dockerfile` `Containerfile` |
| lua | 3 | `.lua` |
| elixir | 3 | `.ex` `.exs` |
| r | 3 | `.r` `.R` |

Files with any other extension, and files the lexer cannot tokenize with confidence, are not checked (the hook fails open).

## Directive families

A directive is recognized only when it matches the tool's documented grammar. Recognition is separate from authorization: a recognized suppression still goes through the suppression policy (justification, scope, allow and deny lists, documentation-rule protection).

| Family | Tools | Languages | Reference | Notes |
| :- | :- | :- | :- | :- |

| `typescript` | TypeScript | javascript, typescript | [docs](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/release-notes/typescript-3-9.html#-ts-expect-error-comments) |  |
